# Dr. Sabina Razdolsky — Obstetrics & Gynecology

> Evidence-based obstetrics and gynecology education by Dr. Sabina Razdolsky, MD. Helping women make informed decisions about their health through medically reviewed, physician-authored content.

## About

Dr. Sabina Razdolsky is a board-certified OB/GYN physician providing educational health content. All articles are written or reviewed by Dr. Razdolsky and grounded in peer-reviewed medical literature.

- Website: https://dr-razdolsky.com
- About: https://dr-razdolsky.com/about/

## Topics

- [Obstetrics](https://dr-razdolsky.com/obstetrics/): Comprehensive obstetric care information including prenatal visits, high-risk pregnancies, and maternal health.
- [Gynecology](https://dr-razdolsky.com/gynecology/): Gynecologic health topics including preventive care, reproductive health, and common conditions.
- [Preconception](https://dr-razdolsky.com/preconception/): Guidance on preparing for pregnancy, fertility optimization, and preconception health.
- [Pregnancy](https://dr-razdolsky.com/pregnancy/): Trimester-by-trimester pregnancy guidance, fetal development, and maternal wellness.
- [Labor & Delivery](https://dr-razdolsky.com/labor-and-delivery/): Information about labor stages, delivery options, birth plans, and what to expect.
- [Postpartum](https://dr-razdolsky.com/postpartum/): Postpartum recovery, newborn care, breastfeeding, and maternal mental health.
- [Procedures](https://dr-razdolsky.com/procedures/): Common OB/GYN procedures explained, including what to expect before, during, and after.

## Resources

- [Articles](https://dr-razdolsky.com/articles/): Library of evidence-based articles on women's health topics.
- [Research & Publications](https://dr-razdolsky.com/research/): Dr. Razdolsky's research contributions and published work.

## Policies

- [Editorial Policy](https://dr-razdolsky.com/editorial-policy/): How content is created, reviewed, and maintained to ensure medical accuracy.
- [Medical Disclaimer](https://dr-razdolsky.com/disclaimer/): This website provides educational information only and is not a substitute for professional medical care.
